items.note: Clarksons Denmark hired a one-year full-time Shipbroker Intern for 2026 (now filled). A 2027 round has not been announced and the opening date is a guess. The widget checks Clarksons' job list every few hours and puts any new Clarksons role in Europe at the top. Ask your Clarksons Copenhagen contact whether they plan a 2027 intern.

items.place: Oslo, London, Singapore, Dubai, Hamburg, New York and more
items.watchKey: trainee broker programme|global trainee broker|\b2027 intake\b
items.note: The flagship route to becoming a Clarksons broker. Last round, London closed 16 Feb 2026 and other offices stayed open longer. Recent cohorts sat in Oslo, London, Singapore, Dubai, Hamburg, Tokyo, Shanghai, New York and Connecticut, so you can apply to any of them; offices outside the EEA need a work visa, so ask about sponsorship for those. Opening date is an estimate, set early on purpose so you start checking from 1 November.

Listed on Clarksons' own job board (posted 14 Oct 2026) as a new office with various opportunities. It is not an entry-level programme, and Monaco is outside the EU/EEA, so a work permit is needed. Worth a short email to Clarksons expressing interest, ideally through your Clarksons Copenhagen contact.
Two openings: one supporting the container team, one the bulk/tanker team. MB's job list shows 30 Oct, and the posting says they screen and interview on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.
Open through their job portal, currently listed with an end date of 31 Dec 2026 (it is renewed each year). Useful for flagging interest in the 2027 trainee intake early.

items.place: All offices (London, Singapore, Hong Kong, Dubai, Greece, Hamburg, Copenhagen, Bergen, Geneva and more)
items.note: Howe Robinson says trainee opportunities exist in all its offices and departments, and that it regularly takes summer interns. Send CV and cover letter to recruitment@howerob.com quoting reference TR20 and name the office you want. Offices outside the EEA need a work visa.
Letter, CV, transcripts and references to career@fearnleys.com.

Grieg Shipbrokers (Bergen and Oslo) has run summer intern places in dry bulk, offshore and maritime finance; the 2026 places were filled. No 2027 round is posted yet. Send an open application now so you are considered.

items.start: Flexible; Academy trainees start every September
items.note: Their 2026/2027 Academy round is closed, but they take unsolicited applications at applications@lightshipchartering.com.

12-month shipbroking programme. The 2026 round closed 31 January 2026. Eligible with a business education. Ifchor Galbraiths' offices are Lausanne and London; the page does not say where trainees sit.
12-month programme. The 2026 round (August start) was posted on finn.no and closed 21 January 2026. The finn.no feed in the widget picks up the new ad.

Fearnleys' 2026 summer programme was in London (29 June to 21 August) and closed 27 March 2026. Oslo, Geneva and Singapore dates are not published, so email career@fearnleys.com now and ask. London needs a UK work visa.
MB's 2026 Copenhagen trainee ad was published 16 Feb 2026, and they recruit through March and April. Two years with the Danish Shipping Academy, then a permanent job.
12-month programme rotating through offices and departments. Closed now with no 2027 dates, so also send an unsolicited CV through the page.

12-month desk-based trainee scheme. SSY's February 2026 round took trainees in London, Athens, Oslo, Bergen and Hamburg; that round opened 9 February 2026. Name the office you want when you apply; London needs a UK work visa, Oslo, Bergen, Hamburg and Athens do not.

Three-month internship on SSY's freight derivatives (FFA) broking desk in London, with various start dates and no closing date shown. Email your CV and a short cover note to careers@ssyglobal.com with 'Internships: Derivatives Broking' in the subject line and say when you can start. SSY checks UK right to work and says nothing about sponsorship, so ask before applying; a Norwegian needs a UK work visa.
Product tanker owner. Student assistants (15-20 h/week) are hired as departments need them; set up TORM's job agent to be told first.

items.role: Shipping Talent Pipeline (internships, trainee and graduate roles)
items.note: Dry bulk operator with a large chartering desk. This is an open invitation to be considered for internships, trainee roles and graduate jobs across their offices, with no deadline. Join it now so you are on their list before roles are posted.

items.place: Geneva, Singapore, Amsterdam or Coral Gables (Miami)
items.note: Chartering and freight trading desk of one of the largest charterers. The 2026 intake ran in Geneva, Singapore and Coral Gables and its postings have now been taken down; 2027 dates are not published yet, so search Cargill careers for 'Ocean Transport'. Singapore and the US need a work visa.

items.place: Oslo or other Western Bulk offices
items.note: Dry bulk operator with a big chartering desk. Last year's 12-month Commercial Trainee round was posted 15 Oct 2025 and closed 7 Nov 2025, leading to a junior chartering role. As of 26 Oct 2026 no new round is posted and Western Bulk's careers page lists no trainee programme, so this year's round may be late or skipped. A bachelor's is enough, though 1-2 years of sales or trading experience is preferred. Email trainee@westernbulk.com or register in their candidate portal now.

Two-year Shipping Trainee programme in chartering and operations with a September start, including the Danish Shipping Academy. Norden's own career page says recruitment starts in December, so check from 1 December. Previous rounds closed 16 March and 27 April 2025, and the 2026 Annapolis (US) round closed 26 April 2026, so the deadline is an estimate. The US office asked for existing US work rights; Copenhagen needs no permit. Norden's 9-month intern role is only for CBS International Shipping and Trade students.
Tankers. Two-year programme with the Danish Shipping Academy.

Applications open now. Commodity trader with its own shipping arm (Clearlake Shipping). Degree must be finished by June 2027. The page gives no closing date and says decisions are made by year end; last year's window closed 31 October, so apply this week.

LNG shipping company. Open to 3rd and 4th year students in business and other fields; you must pick a project. Most projects are technical; Business Development and Legal sit in London (UK work permit needed). The finn.no ad (updated 12 Oct) confirms the 8 November deadline. Candidates are assessed continuously, so apply early.

Agricultural commodity trader with a large freight desk in Geneva. The 2026 programme was Geneva-based for 18 months and closed 6 March 2026, so dates for 2027 are estimates. Rotations cover trading and operations; freight is not guaranteed.

Posted 13 Oct 2026 on the crude oil desk (Link Crude and Link Futures). Training is provided and the job includes taking the US Series 3 and 30 licences. No closing date, so apply early. The ad says nothing about work authorisation; a Norwegian needs a US work visa, so ask Clarksons whether they sponsor.

items.start: Mid June to mid July 2027 (2026 ran 15 Jun to 17 Jul)
items.note: Five weeks rotating across Clarksons' London broking desks, and it can lead to a full-time job. The 2026 round closed 9 Feb 2026. Clarksons requires the right to work in the UK and says it cannot sponsor visas, and Norwegians are not in the UK Youth Mobility Scheme, so this only works if you get UK work rights another way. Clarksons' Oslo summer internship 2027 closed on 2 October 2026, so next year look for the Oslo round from early September.

Braemar says its next round opens in 2027. The 2026 round opened 18 March and closed 19 April 2026 for a September start, with the final round in person in London. The page says nothing about visa sponsorship, so ask.

items.place: London, Singapore, Dubai, Athens, Hong Kong, Houston, Mumbai
items.note: Two-year scheme rotating across the company, with time in at least two Gibson offices; selection is an annual assessment centre and interviews. Gibson says details of the next intake are coming soon and welcomes speculative applications (enquiries@eagibson.co.uk). Athens is visa-free for you; the other offices need a work visa.

Two-year rotation through commercial operations, chartering, bunkers and claims at one of the largest dry bulk owners. Pacific Basin says it will publish 2027 details by the end of this year; last time you applied by email to recruiting@pacificbasin.com naming the position and location. Hong Kong needs an employer-sponsored work visa.

Applications for the 2027 programme are open now, with no closing date shown, so apply early. The working language is English and you need a completed or nearly completed degree. Operations at one of the largest dry bulk operators works side by side with the chartering desk. Oldendorff's German-language requirement applies to its apprenticeship, not this programme.

items.start: Six-week paid internship from September 2027, then a 12-month traineeship from October
items.note: Chartering traineeship: a paid internship first, then three interns are offered the 12-month traineeship. Oldendorff's overview page says applications for selected 2027 programmes are open, but the chartering page still only says 2026 is closed, so check both and email if unclear. Germany is visa-free for you; Singapore and Dubai need a work visa.

items.place: Singapore (rotations in Hamburg, London and China)
items.note: Dry bulk market research trainee programme with applications for the 2026 and 2027 intakes open on a rolling basis. For final-year students or graduates of the past two years in economics, finance, business or similar. Singapore needs an Employment Pass from the employer.

London early-careers roles at the world's largest independent oil trader, which runs one of the biggest tanker chartering desks. Applications are closed now and Vitol says to check back in winter, so the opening date is an estimate. For final-year students and recent graduates.
